findings.reason: by its own stated criterion the node finds a listing surface and must record it and leave the file, directly contradicting the plan's stated outcome that both files are deleted; the node must define "reachable" as rendered by a call site, distinct from "registered by the prompt registry".
findings.text: the §23 orphan node's reachability criterion states "no MCP or CLI surface that lists every prompt file", but `load_prompts()` reads every `.md` under `prompts/`, `list_prompts_summary()` (prompt_loader.py:199) lists them, and `MCP server._register_prompts` (imas_codex/llm/server.py:3720) registers each one — including both files §23 proposes to delete

— the plan says "the only mention of individualization in code is a log string in imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py", but the file's frontmatter carries `used_by: imas_codex.discovery.signals.parallel.individualize_source_descriptions`, and that function exists and is called (parallel.py:4245, invoked at parallel.py:5275) — it renders `signals/source_unwind`, the dynamic schema-driven successor of the same prompt family (both declare `task: individualization` and the same `used_by`), WOULD_CHANGE_THE_PLAN: yes — REASON: the honest disposition is "superseded by source_unwind, delete (or reconcile the two)", not "a file that never had a loader"; the plan's premise sends the node looking for a loader that does not exist while missing the live function and the frontmatter pointer that make the supersession legible.

findings.reason: the node's two files need different dispositions and one criterion, so the plan should split the reachability test or state per-file how "no loader" is to be established, otherwise the node records a false "loader" for one file and stops short of the deletion it promises.
findings.text: the orphan node half for `imas_codex/llm/prompts/discovery/enricher.md` is sound (no call site, no `used_by`, only the `prompt_loader` docstring names it) but the two halves share one criterion that is unsatisfiable as written for the individualization file

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the new behaviour in the open sections is added behind existing interfaces (`reset_to_status(path_prefixes=...)` renders its own scope through one `render_path_prefix_clause`; the §23 guard replaces assertions inside the existing `tests/llm/test_prompt_schema_coverage.py`), so no new module spreads one mechanism across shallow wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — §14 removes a duplicate rather than adding one: the public `discovery_roots` in `imas_codex/config/facilities/jt-60sa.yaml` replaces the never-scanned `/analysis/src` parent, seeding goes through the existing `seed_facility_roots`, and both the path and code resets pass a prefix list to the single renderer `imas_codex/graph/query_builder.py:render_path_prefix_clause` instead of each spelling the clause.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; neither open section adds a CLI option, MCP view, refusal family or public definition. `--root`, `--path-prefix` and `--reset-to` already exist (`imas_codex/cli/discover/paths.py:21,90`, `imas_codex/cli/discover/code.py`), and §23 only tightens a test and deletes files, so there is no added surface for a section to account for.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan's §23 orphan node rests on two absence claims that the code contradicts: `load_prompts()`/`list_prompts_summary` and the MCP `_register_prompts` already enumerate every prompt file, and `signals/individualization.md` is not "only mentioned as a log string" — its own `used_by` frontmatter names a live function.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the one candidate layer is `render_path_prefix_clause`, and the plan justifies it as a consolidation (it retires five inline path-claim clauses in `imas_codex/cli/discover/paths.py` and seven hand-wired call sites) rather than a parallel path, which is the extension the item asks for.
